info.title: Ikon SEO
info.description: Audits, plans, measures, creates, improves and safely approves SEO-focused WordPress pages.

get.summary: Read the active website identity, schema policy and publishing rules before writing

post.summary: Read the active website strategy and operating mode; save an approved strategy update only when save is true
Read workflow state; create mode-based workflows, update or approve tasks, run read-only automation and generate briefings
Read or update the keyword universe, topic hubs, editorial pipeline, contributor profiles, quality gates, lifecycle recommendations and portfolio signatures
Read the multi-site portfolio, refresh read-only snapshots, record budgets and resolve portfolio alerts

get.summary: Find existing pages before creating content

post.summary: Create a page or separate improvement draft

get.summary: Read page content, SEO, schema and quality data

patch.summary: Update an Ikon SEO managed draft

get.summary: Audit pages, links, metadata, orphans and keyword overlap
Read page-level technical, Search Console and Analytics evidence with categorised findings, evidence sufficiency, business value and clear limitations
Read URL discovery, sitemap parity, internal-link graph, redirect evidence and PageSpeed/Core Web Vitals findings

post.summary: Read and manage quota-aware Google index evidence, canonical disagreements, inspection queues and production health checks
Read stored competitor and content intelligence; optionally store current competitor observations or create a page-level content brief
Read imported authority and off-site evidence; optionally store approved backlink or competitor-link observations
Read or refresh the unified operating plan, manage recommendation states, capture baselines, measure outcomes and create recovery checkpoints

get.summary: Compare an improvement draft with its live source

post.summary: Merge an approved draft into its original page
post.description: Disabled by default. Requires the approve key scope and Remote merge setting.

get.summary: Read the persistent page-query database, query clusters, cannibalisation evidence, striking-distance opportunities and content decay
Read current and previous landing-page sessions, users, engagement, views and key events
List CSV-imported page plans awaiting interactive generation

post.summary: Claim one page plan for up to one hour before generating its payload
Validate a completed page payload, create its WordPress draft and complete the page plan

get.summary: Read overdue reviews, upcoming refresh dates and meaningful Search Console declines

post.summary: Read durable project history and optionally save one completed, pending or recommended project event
Read local growth readiness; refresh approved evidence, synchronize review and conversion workflows, and store competitor-prominence observations without changing public profiles

get.summary: Read profile-bound storefront, hybrid and service-area records before preparing local content

post.summary: Read and manage privacy-preserving cross-site quality evidence, differentiation risks and review gates

event_ref.description: An internal reference that is hashed before storage.

metadata.description: Optional non-identifying metadata. Do not include names, email addresses, phone numbers, addresses or message content.

save.description: Leave false to read strategy. Set true only after an approved strategy update.

map_query.description: Verified address or place query for the native Elementor map widget.

profile_id.description: Current profile_id returned by GET /profile. Prevents cross-client writes.

LocalPage.description: Required for schema.page_type=location. Verified locations and service areas use different safety policies.

show_address.description: Must be false for service-area pages.

emit_location_entity.description: Must be false for service-area pages.

SchemaConfig.description: Allow-listed schema configuration. FAQ rich results are retired; semantic FAQ markup is optional.

business_entity.description: Optional explicit entity node. Its type is always taken from the active Website Profile.

accounting_service.description: v0.2 compatibility only; rejected outside an AccountingService profile.

claim_token.description: One-time token returned by the claim action. It expires after one hour.

LocalGrowthSync.description: Call with command read to inspect the Local Growth System. Refresh and synchronization commands remain read-only toward public profiles. Review workflow updates and prominence observations store planning evidence only.

WorkspaceSync.description: Call with an empty object to resume project context. Optionally include one event or one status update, then receive the refreshed project state.

AuthoritySync.description: Call with an empty object to read imported authority evidence. Optionally store approved link observations. Imported provider metrics remain labelled evidence and are never converted into a proprietary authority score.

competitor_domain.description: Required when relationship is competitor_backlink unless it can be inferred from every target URL.

source_strength.description: Optional provider metric retained without cross-provider normalization.

CompetitorContentSync.description: Call with an empty object to read the current competitor and content intelligence state. Optionally store up to 50 current competitor observations and/or create one page-level brief. Never copy competitor content or treat competitor claims as facts about the connected business.

snapshot_id.description: Optional. The newest snapshot is used when omitted.

url.description: Must be on the current WordPress website.

GBPDraft.description: Stages content locally. It cannot send, publish or reply until a WordPress administrator approves the exact draft.
